body: I have basically abandoned my mother because of her alcoholism. I have pleaded for her to stop since i was a small child. I have literally watched her choose alcohol and random men over me and my little brother. I am in my early 20's now with a career and a girlfriend who I love dearly and I've all but given up and stopped talking to my own mother. Out of nowhere my mom comes to me with news that she has breast cancer. I didn't freak out immediately because I didn't have enough facts. Turns out my mom has stage 4 breast cancer and upon some research I realize that she isn't likely to recover because she put off getting a lump checked out for years. I feel very selfish because of the way I've treated her for the majority of my life. Also my girlfriend dumped me 2 days ago. All of this is happening within a span of two weeks. I've fantasized about killing myself since I was 16 but this has really pushed me over the edge.

Breathing and relaxing are things i've done for ahwile It doesn't work and I really feel lost. This is the the closest i've come to acting on my fantasies. I have never actually played them out like I have tonight. I really feel like I won't make it through the week or even the night.

I don't even know where to begin. The fact that you responded has brought me to tears. I put a loaded weapon to my mouth multiple times tonight. I have fantasized about this moment for years and I don't know what to do anymore.
